access.notes: Open‑source DFT code; agent must compile and use a SIESTA executable (version 4.x or compatible).

resources.name: PBE Troullier–Martins pseudopotentials for Ga and Li

access.notes: Standard norm‑conserving GGA‑PBE pseudopotentials from the SIESTA pseudopotential database.

Orthorhombic structure: space group Cmcm (No. 63), a=4.632 Å, b=9.693 Å, c=4.453 Å. Atomic positions: Ga at 4c (0, 0.085, 1/4); Li(1) at 4c (0, 0.417, 1/4); Li(2) at 4c (0, 0.750, 1/4). Coordinates are given in the paper and can also be obtained from ICSD #61233. The agent must create an input geometry file (CIF/POSCAR) from these coordinates.
